plan.assume.ESTIMATED_TAX_AT_CURRENT_RAT: Future tax is estimated at the current rate.
plan.assume.HISTORY_AVERAGE: Usual income and expenses are averages of past months; the range is from the worst to the best month.
plan.assume.ONLY_KNOWN_PAYMENTS: No history — only known invoices and taxes are included.
plan.assume.RECEIVABLES_PAID_ON_DUE_DATE: Invoices are paid on time; in the bad case overdue ones are not paid.
plan.assume.STARTING_CASH_ZERO: Account balance not given — the forecast starts at zero.
plan.assume.TAX_ON_CASH_RECEIPTS: Tax is calculated on money received, by the date received.
plan.closing: end of month: bad {low} · usual {base} · good {high}
plan.disclaimer: The forecast is an estimate based on your data, not a guarantee of income or the exact amount of future tax.
plan.forecastLead: Based on {n} months of history, known invoices and tax deadlines. This is an estimate, not a promise of income.
plan.note.ACTUAL_RESERVE_UNKNOWN: Enter how much you have set aside to see the difference.
plan.note.EMPLOYEE_TAXES_NOT_INCLUDED: Income tax and social payments for employees are not included.
plan.note.GENERAL_NOT_SUPPORTED: The general regime is not calculated — no reserve is determined.
plan.note.INCOMPLETE_PERIODS: Tax was not calculated for some periods — the reserve may be understated.
plan.note.MICRO_NO_TURNOVER_TAX: A micro-business pays no turnover tax on this activity.
plan.note.RECEIVABLES_ESTIMATE: Tax on unpaid invoices is an estimate: it arises when the money arrives.
plan.warn.NO_HISTORY: No transaction history — the forecast uses known payments only.
plan.warn.NO_STARTING_CASH: Enter the account balance to see whether the money will suffice.
plan.warn.POSSIBLE_SHORTFALL_FOR_TAX: {month}: in the bad case there may not be enough money for taxes of {taxes} (balance {closingLow})
plan.warn.SHORT_HISTORY: Only {months} months of history — the forecast is rough.
